title: ELMO
tagline: It's Venmo, but for Layer 2 -- Exchange L2 Money Optimistically
description: Elmo just wants to give and get money from all his friends without paying so much money for gas. This project uses Optimism's layer 2 architecture to enable fast, (near) gasless transactions on Ethereum. We wrote the deployment scripts in Python which didn't natively support working with the OVM. I was impressed with the team's ability to understand how Optimism's layer 2 rollup schema worked.
